topology: 2 nodes x 1 rank, MPI one-sided Put/Get/Accumulate/Fetch_and_op over an MPI_Win_allocate window plus MPI_Ssend, captured with the UCX and ibverbs providers CO-RUNNING in one shared pass
golden: none — assertions only. Nothing here pins a row COUNT: how many keys MPI unpacks for one window, and whether an accumulate becomes a device atomic or an active message, are the MPI and UCX implementations' decisions and not facts this project should freeze.
workload_note:
`tests/hpc/probes/ucx_rma_doors/rma_doors.c`. Ten MPI_Put then ten MPI_Get of rma_bytes at a rotating offset into a win_bytes window, then ten MPI_Accumulate and ten MPI_Fetch_and_op on the LAST BYTE of that window, then ten MPI_Ssend/MPI_Recv exchanges. MPI_UNSIGNED_CHAR throughout, for 21_ucx_deep's reason: UcxTagSend.count is a UCP datatype count and equals bytes only for a contiguous 8-bit datatype.

WHY IT IS NOT 21_ucx_deep. That case varies SIZE to make UCX pick different transport protocols, and pins UCX_ZCOPY_THRESH / RNDV_THRESH / TM_THRESH to do it. This one varies the MPI CALL to make MPI reach different UCP doors, and deliberately leaves the thresholds alone — the sizes sit well inside the defaults because protocol selection is the other case's question. Two axes, two cases, neither subsuming the other.

THE DOORS IT IS HERE TO WITNESS. PLAN-20260815-1540 Future work 2 records that the _nbi RMA doors, the three atomic doors and ucp_tag_send_sync_nb were hooked on a STATIC ELF SURVEY of MN5's HPC-X and never observed firing on hardware. MPI_Put/MPI_Get reach ucp_put_nbi/ucp_get_nbi (the survey found MPI one-sided makes no _nbx RMA call at all on this machine), MPI_Accumulate and MPI_Fetch_and_op reach the atomic doors, and MPI_Ssend reaches the legacy synchronous tagged door — which is NOT a duplicate of an ordinary send, since it completes only once the receiver has matched.

AND THE KEYS THOSE DOORS NAME. Every ucx_rma and ucx_atomic row interns a ucp_rkey_h. Until ucx_rkey (626) existed nothing recorded one being created, so that handle joined to nothing at all — the same shape of defect as an entity referenced by events that nothing opens. mca_osc_ucx calls ucp_ep_rkey_unpack, ucp_rkey_pack and ucp_rkey_destroy on this machine, measured by an undefined-symbol survey of its own libraries, so MPI RMA is precisely the workload that fills the record.

--mca osc ucx IS LOAD-BEARING and 21_ucx_deep learned it the expensive way: with osc/rdma or osc/pt2pt an MPI_Put becomes an active message, no rkey is ever unpacked, and this case's central table is empty for a reason that has nothing to do with the provider.

-p ucx,ib IS THE POINT OF THE PROVIDER LIST. Both are hook-based and non-exclusive, so they share one pass and one engine rather than forcing a replay. The UCX plan's definition of done requires this and it had never been run; the smoke job that ran used -p ucx with the verbs provider compiled out. ib_post_send is EXPECTED to stay empty — UCX registers through ibverbs and posts through nothing exported — so ib_mem_region is the verbs witness the assertion uses.
